ksp_mappings.explanation: Workflow productivity contributes to the office prompts using contracts, invoices, forms, project documentation, and shared workteam desks. It is not forced into café, gaming, home, education, or creative-studio alternatives when the setting is unsupported.

Enterprise security informs the source audit and office context, but security policies are not visualized as special props because the tight scene can only show an ordinary surface and at most one prop.

Fleet integration and lifecycle adaptability support the managed-enterprise office context in scoring, but technical integration details are omitted from prompt prose because they are not visible lifestyle scene materials.
Sustainability is acknowledged as a messaging pillar but omitted from prompt concepts because certifications and environmental credentials do not naturally become ordinary C-Tech lifestyle props.

value_proposition.explanation: Together the documents position the product around managed enterprise document workflows, shared workteams, business-critical documents, security, and fleet readiness. The strongest visual translation is an ordinary modern office desk or shared table with a simple stack of contracts, invoices, forms, or project documentation; non-office alternatives are retained only for required environment diversity and labeled as departures.

debug.input_assessment: Both supplied documents describe the same enterprise monochrome document-workflow product context. Useful scene cues include corporate offices, shared workteams, departmental functions, business documents, contracts, invoices, forms, project documentation, and tidy professional environments. The camera tag is a tight oblique printer view with one local prop and no background details, so wide C-Tech room inventories were reduced heavily.
debug.count_explanation: Generated exactly 20 distinct prompts. The set genuinely covers Home, Office, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio while preserving the tight one-prop/no-background camera scope.
ignored_fields: Search-rank and SEO metadata were treated as positioning context, not lifestyle scene evidence.
Technical specifications, security stack names, firmware, connectivity, certifications, and speed claims were not turned into visible props.
Product brand, model, and device type were excluded from prompt text.
Transport or authoring metadata was not used.
debug.diversity_summary: The highest-scoring prompts are office scenes because both documents support enterprise document workflows. Diversity is added through home workspace, living-room end table, café tables, creative office tables, education tables, and gaming desks, with unsupported environments marked as creative departures. Because the camera profile is tight, diversity is mostly in surface type, prop choice, and lighting rather than room background.
limitations: The fixed camera permits at most one local prop and no background details, so many reference objects and room-depth clauses had to be omitted.
The source materials support office and enterprise document workflows much more strongly than home, café, education, gaming, or creative-studio settings.
No people were included because the camera profile says to omit people.
No runtime image inspection or SKU-specific geometry was used.
